changes: Original text/readings retained; eligible annotations joined into spaced readings and compact numeric/tone-free inputs, deduplicated and sampled under the recorded policy.
citation: K. K. Luke and May L. Y. Wong (2015), The Hong Kong Cantonese Corpus: Design and Uses, Journal of Chinese Linguistics Monograph Series 25, 312–333.
purpose: Frozen corpus-derived canonical-input external annotation baseline; no independent natural typing or clean held-out claim.

selection_policy.eligibility: Chinese ideographs only and complete lowercase [a-z]+[1-6] source syllables; source POS w is punctuation. No dictionary-inventory filter, tone conversion, text normalization, guessed reading or bridging of unsupported tokens.
selection_policy.length: Exclude an entire unit if its fully toned compact input exceeds 64 raw characters; report all exclusions.
selection_policy.metric: Exact source text at ranks 1/9/90; exact source text AND reading separately. No unreviewed orthographic alternatives accepted.
selection_policy.quality_scope: External corpus annotations, not clean held-out accuracy, casual spelling, human acceptance or native IME validation. Source/dictionary overlap is reported after selection and is not an eligibility filter.
selection_policy.selection: Lowest SHA-256(unit NUL text NUL spaced_reading), equally allocated by unit; independent of dictionary contents/ranking.
selection_policy.speech_span: Distinct maximal consecutive eligible-token text/reading pairs within one source sent_tag; punctuation or any ineligible token ends a span; minimum two source tokens; no clipping of long spans.
selection_policy.word_type: Distinct eligible source text/reading pairs, including one-syllable words; all occurrences counted and first source occurrence retained.
